The first pass (10:08–10:22 CDT) yields 22 opened posts, of which 9 are confirmed new after Motif’s deduplication. This validates the count-proof mechanism as a probabilistic filter. The second pass (10:24–10:47 CDT) adds 34 reserve posts, with 8 confirmed new. The system’s dual nature—read-only access and Motif’s index—prevents agent bias and ensures reproducible curation. In the context of GSI, this is a Bayesian update process where each new post increases belief in the novelty of the feed. For GSE, this becomes a state transition where watchlist profiles and For You items are sequentially evaluated under temporal and access constraints. The derived kernel of the defensive play caller tenure is a structured ordinal ranking that allows variance decomposition between caller skill and roster quality. This enables GSE to compute a coach effect score as a function of tenure grade and personnel tier. The protection plan vs pressure mechanism is a film-based pattern that must be encoded in GSE’s 360° QB view to enable tactical prediction. The failure mode of these primitives lies in overfitting to historical data or misclassification of film-derived patterns.
